name: POST /api/voice-agent/stack-profiles - Create a stack profile from a preset
description: Clones a preset (budget | balanced | premium) into a tenant stack profile, applying optional per-layer overrides, and binds provider credentials BY REFERENCE: credential_refs maps a layer (telephony, stt, llm_fast, llm_complex, tts) to {primary, secondary?} ai-gateway tenant-credential binding ids — never raw keys. Covers deef80bf-b0ce-4295-9cf0-878c4f5bfd02#AC3: a tenant can create a stack profile from a preset, and the create is REJECTED with 422 CredentialInvalid when any referenced credential does not exist for the tenant or is revoked. tenant_id may be omitted (taken from the JWT); if given it must match the JWT tenant or the call is 403 Forbidden. `complete` in the response is true only when every required layer has a primary credential. Names are unique per tenant (409 Conflict). Every catalog layer (stt, llm_fast, llm_complex, tts) must use a certified speech catalog entry (322b0d69-8fde-47e0-aaf7-8c6420ed492b#AC3); otherwise the request is refused with 422 UncertifiedProvider naming each layer. allow_uncertified: true is an explicit opt-in that saves the profile flagged certified=false. The response carries certified and layer_certification, both evaluated live, so a later revocation shows on read.
